br.hud.mechanism: Mechanism, not a structure — nothing is holding this up
br.engine.refused: The engine could not solve this: %s
br.hud.stale: stale — world changed since this was computed
br.hud.truncated: overlay incomplete — showing %s of %s members, %s of %s facets
br.msg.load_dropped: Test load at %s %s %s removed: that block forms no structural element on its own.
br.hud.aim: Look at a member for its section
br.hud.plate_recovered: support moment recovered at this edge
br.load.not_structural: Aim at a structural block. /br load applies a test load where you look.
br.hud.model_incomplete: %s block(s) outside the loaded area — parts of this structure are not judged
br.buckling.no_positive_eigenvalue: buckling checked: nothing here buckles under this load
br.buckling.not_eligible: buckling not run: no structure to run it on
br.buckling.unknown: buckling: the reply did not say
br.unassigned.run_too_short: %s block(s) left out: each sits in a piece one block long
br.unassigned.plate_lone: %s plate block(s) left out: no plate neighbour on any axis
br.unassigned.plate_strip: %s plate block(s) left out: a strip one block wide closes no facet
br.unassigned.plate_solid: %s plate block(s) left out: stacked solid, and a solid is not a shell
br.unassigned.plate_no_facet: %s plate block(s) left out: no complete 2x2 facet around them
br.unassigned.mechanism: %s block(s) in a structure nothing is holding up
br.unassigned.fully_supported: %s block(s) fully supported — in the model, nothing to report
br.unassigned.unknown: %s block(s) left out for a reason this build does not know
br.hud.focus_withheld: not judged: this member runs into unloaded chunks
br.engine.platform: No bundled engine for this platform (%s) — analysis is off. You can build br-sidecar from source and point sidecarPath at it.
